If by “AI visibility tracking” you mean tracking how often your company/product appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI results, etc., the market has matured quite a bit. As of September 2026, these are the tools I’d put at the top:

- Profound — Best overall / enterprise. Strong answer-engine analytics, citation/source analysis, competitor benchmarking, AI bot tracking, and optimization workflows. It’s built specifically around AEO/GEO rather than bolting AI tracking onto SEO. ([tryprofound.com](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing?utm_source=openai))
- Peec AI — Best dedicated tracker for most marketing teams. Particularly good for prompt-level monitoring, share-of-voice, competitor comparisons, and straightforward dashboards. It’s a good middle ground between simple monitors and enterprise platforms.
- Ahrefs Brand Radar — Best if you already use Ahrefs. It tracks brand presence across seven AI platforms and combines that with Ahrefs' SEO, YouTube, Reddit, and TikTok datasets. Its huge search-backed prompt database is particularly interesting for measuring broader visibility rather than only a hand-picked prompt list. ([help.ahrefs.com](https://help.ahrefs.com/en/articles/11064852-what-is-brand-radar-and-how-to-use-it?utm_source=openai))
- Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit — Best SEO + AI combination. You get AI brand visibility, competitors, prompts and reporting alongside Semrush's traditional search data. Its prompt tracking currently covers ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Gemini. ([semrush.com](https://www.semrush.com/kb/1496-getting-started-with-ai-visibility-toolkit?utm_source=openai))
- Otterly.AI — Best budget/self-service choice. Good if your main requirement is monitoring prompts, mentions, citations/URLs and competitors without buying an enterprise GEO platform.
- Scrunch AI — Best for larger brands wanting to go beyond measurement. It combines AI visibility monitoring with tools aimed at improving how AI agents access and understand your website.
- AthenaHQ / Goodie AI — Also worth evaluating if you're looking for a broader GEO/AEO platform rather than just reporting. Both compete more with Profound/Scrunch than with basic rank trackers.

The bigger issue is that I wouldn't choose one based on its proprietary “AI visibility score.” LLM answers vary between runs, models, locations and prompts. Instead, I’d judge tools on whether they reliably give you four things: prompt-level mentions/rank, citation URLs, competitor share-of-voice, and historical changes. Ahrefs, for example, distinguishes mentions, estimated impressions and share-of-voice rather than reducing everything to one number. ([help.ahrefs.com](https://help.ahrefs.com/en/articles/15501968-ai-visibility-metrics?utm_source=openai))

My shortlist by use case would be: Profound for an enterprise brand or serious GEO program; Peec for a SaaS/marketing team primarily interested in tracking; Ahrefs Brand Radar if AI visibility needs to sit alongside SEO research; Semrush if your organization already lives in Semrush; and Otterly if you want an inexpensive way to start.

If you're deciding what to buy, I can also compare the top 5 on price, ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude/Perplexity coverage, citation tracking, competitor tracking, API access, and agency features.
